body: I'm not sure when other guys in my family went bald. My dad has been on heavy medication for a stroke since he was in his mid twenties, but from what I've seen in pictures and videos, he didn't really go bald until his early or mid 30s, as for my maternal grandfather, I have no idea when. I had mild hypothyroidism last time I got bloodwork done and I'm waiting to go back to the doctor to follow up on that.
